requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 A1 温度传感器（LM35）：温度 > 30℃ 时风扇（D5 PWM）开启，否则关闭
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 sampled such that temperature is at 30.0℃ (input equals adc_count for 30.0℃ under unit scale), then io_0 sampled such that temperature is at 30.01℃
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 equals 0.0 when temperature is 30.0℃, and io_1 equals 1.0 when temperature is 30.01℃
